name: Fulu Familiar

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text: You can imprint your familiar's spiritual essence into a fulu, a small paper charm that can be affixed to objects, creatures, or structures. You gain the Create Familiar Fulu action, which you can use once per day; at 12th level, this increases to twice per day, and at 18th level, it increases to three times per day.
